Các vitamin (natri ascorbat, vitamin E, niacin, calci D-pantothenat, vitamin B6, vitamin B1, vitamin A, vitamin B2, acid folic, vitamin K1, vitamin K2, biotin, vitamin D3, vitamin B12)
